cross_pulse_interface.pre_p: canonical HR4C PRE generation with {phase=PRE, pulse_index=p}

cross_pulse_interface.post_mapping: POST.delta_n = PRE.delta_n + authoritative HR3B increment; POST.vx = PRE.vx; POST.vy = PRE.vy
cross_pulse_interface.post_commit: all intervals exactly once, then one atomic HR4C POST commit
cross_pulse_interface.hydro: exact 1/f_rep schedule from build_interpulse_step_schedule; frozen advance_hr4_single_screen reused unchanged
cross_pulse_interface.adapter: may stage per-screen NEXT and emit barrier receipts keyed to source POST generation; never becomes authority
cross_pulse_interface.next_pre_commit: after complete barrier, coordinator fills HR4C staging and atomically commits PRE_(p+1); generation and pulse index advance exactly once
cross_pulse_interface.terminal: final pulse commits POST_final; no final interpulse transition
